source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps all four credentials as questions.
key_decisions.before: Am I not free? Am I not an apostle? Have I not seen Jesus our Lord? Are you not my work in the Lord?
key_decisions.after: Am I not free? Am I not an apostle? Have I not seen Jesus our Lord? Are you not my work in the Lord?
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Am I not free? Am I not an apostle? Have I not seen Jesus our Lord? Are you not my work in the Lord?

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps gender, marriage, and named comparators.
key_decisions.before: Do we not have the right to take along a believing wife, as also the other apostles and the brothers and sisters of the Lord and Cephas?
key_decisions.after: Do we not have the right to take along a believing wife, as do the other apostles, the Lord's brothers, and Cephas?
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Do we not have the right to take along a believing wife, as also the other apostles and the brothers of the Lord and Cephas?

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves law attribution, animal care, and question.
key_decisions.before: For it is written in the law of Moses, “You will not muzzle an ox while it is treading out the grain.” Is God concerned about oxen?
key_decisions.after: For in Moses's law it is written, “Do not muzzle an ox while it is threshing grain.” Is God concerned only about oxen?
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For it is written in the law of Moses, “You shall not muzzle an ox while it is treading out the grain.” Is God concerned about oxen?

key_decisions.before: Or is he speaking altogether for our sake? Yes, for our sake it was written, because the one who plows ought to plow in hope, and the one who threshes in hope of sharing.
key_decisions.after: Or is he certainly speaking for our sake? Yes, it was written for us, because the plowman should plow in hope and the thresher thresh in hope of sharing the harvest.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Or is he speaking altogether for our sake? Yes, for our sake it was written, because the one who plows ought to plow in hope, and the one who threshes in hope of sharing.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps renounced right and gospel purpose.
key_decisions.before: If others share this right over you, do we not more? But we did not use this right, but we endure everything so that we may not put any obstacle in the way of the good news of Christ.
key_decisions.after: If others share this right over you, do we not have it even more? Yet we have not used this right. Instead, we endure everything so that we may place no obstacle in Christ's good news.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: If others share this right over you, do we not more? But we did not use this right, but we endure all things so that we may not put any obstacle in the way of the gospel of Christ.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains Paul's broken sentence and vehement boast.
key_decisions.before: Yet I have used none of these things, and I am not writing these things so that it will be done for me; for it would be better for me to die than—no one will empty my boast!
key_decisions.after: But I have used none of these rights. And I am not writing this so that they will be granted to me. I would rather die than—no one will empty my reason for boasting!
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: But I have used none of these things, and I am not writing these things so that it will be done for me; for it would be better for me to die than—no one will empty my boast!

key_decisions.before: For if I do this willingly, I have a reward; but if unwillingly, I am entrusted with a stewardship.
key_decisions.after: For if I do this willingly, I have a reward; but if unwillingly, I have still been entrusted with a stewardship.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For if I do this willingly, I have a reward; but if unwillingly, I am entrusted with a stewardship.

key_decisions.before: What then is my reward? That when I proclaim the good news, I may offer the good news free of charge, so as not to make full use of my right in the good news.
key_decisions.after: What then is my reward? That in proclaiming the good news I may offer it free of charge and not make full use of my right in the good news.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: What then is my reward? That when I proclaim the gospel, I may offer the gospel free of charge, so as not to make full use of my right in the gospel.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves freedom/slavery reversal and mission aim.
key_decisions.before: For though I am free from all, I have made myself a slave to all, so that I may win more.
key_decisions.after: For though I am free from everyone, I made myself a slave to everyone in order to win more people.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For though I am free from all, I have made myself a slave to all, so that I may win more.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps Jewish identity rhetoric and pinned qualification.
key_decisions.before: And to the Jews I became as a Jew, so that I might win Jews; to those under the law, as under the law (though not being myself under the law), so that I might win those under the law;
key_decisions.after: To the Jews I became like a Jew, to win Jews. To those under the law I became like one under the law—though I myself am not under the law—to win those under the law.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And to the Jews I became as a Jew, so that I might win Jews; to those under the law, as under the law (though not being myself under the law), so that I might win those under the law;

key_decisions.before: to those without the law, as without the law (though not being without law toward God but under the law of Christ), so that I might win those without the law.
key_decisions.after: To those outside the law I became like one outside the law—though I am not outside God's law but under Christ's law—to win those outside the law.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: to those without the law, as without the law (though not being without law toward God but under the law of Christ), so that I might win those without the law.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps repeated weak, expansive adaptation, and limited some.
key_decisions.before: To the weak I became weak, so that I might win the weak. I have become everything to all people, so that by all means I might save some.
key_decisions.after: To the weak I became weak, to win the weak. I have become all things to all people, so that by every possible means I might save some.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: To the weak I became weak, so that I might win the weak. I have become all things to all people, so that by all means I might save some.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains harsh bodily discipline and disqualification risk.
key_decisions.before: but I discipline my body and bring it into subjection, lest after proclaiming to others, I myself should become disqualified.
key_decisions.after: Instead, I strike my body and make it my slave, so that after proclaiming to others I myself will not be disqualified.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: but I discipline my body and bring it into subjection, lest after proclaiming to others, I myself should become disqualified.
